questions.q: Three of the following four number-pairs are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.

Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with the commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All teachers are painters.

Some painters are rich.

Conclusions:

I. All painters are teachers.

II. Some rich are not painters.
options: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. All painters are teachers → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some rich are not painters → False (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.q: At a party, the number of girls is half the number of boys. After an hour, five boys leave the party and three girls join the party. If the number of boys and girls are equal, then find how many people were present at the party an hour before?
questions.solution:
Let the number of girls at the starting of the party be ‘x’

Then, number of boys = 2 × x = 2x

Given, five boys leave the party and three girls join the party

Number of boys now = 2x – 5

Number of girls = x + 3

According to the question,

(2x – 5) : (x + 3) = 1 : 1

On solving,

x = 8

number of girls = 8

number of boys = 8 × 2 = 16

∴ Required number of people = 8 + 16 = 24

Hence, the correct answer is 24.

A is 40% more efficient than B and C is 20% less efficient than B. Working together, they can finish a task in 15 days. In how many days, will B alone complete 75% of the task?
questions.solution:
Let the efficiency of B be 100.

Efficiency of A will be = 100 × [140/100] = 140

Efficiency of C will be = 100 × [80/100] = 80

Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 140 ∶ 100 ∶ 80 = 7 ∶ 5 ∶ 4

Total work = (7 + 5 + 4) × 15 = 240

75% of total work = 240 × [75/100] = 180

75% of total work B will complete in = 180/5 = 36 days

With stoppages average speed = 52 km/h

questions.q:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

questions.solution:
The word rice is an uncountable noun. Therefore, it is incorrect to quantify it with the adjective many.

It is instead correct to refer to a quantity of rice with adjectives used for non-countable nouns, such as much or a lot of.

In this sentence, it would be correct to say-- there isn't much rice left....

Therefore, the error is in option 4.

questions.q:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The sailors had never encountered such a rough sea.
options: Such a rough sea was never encountered by the sailors
Such a rough sea had never been encountered by the sailors.
Such a rough sea is never encountered by the sailors.
Such a rough sea has never been encountered by the sailors
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Such a rough sea had never been encountered by the sailors.

Key Points

• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.

• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.

• The given sentence is in the active voice and 'The sailors' is the subject and 'such a rough sea' is the object.

• When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject 'The sailors' of the active voice becomes the object, the object 'such a rough sea' becomes the subject.

• The passive format "had + been + V3 (encountered)" should be used.

• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past perfect tense.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
